description: Implementation of ClientSocketPoolManager for managing socket pools, including creation, error handling, and info serialization within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManagerImpl
classes.description: Manages a collection of socket pools, providing methods to retrieve, flush, close, and serialize socket pool info.

methods.name: ClientSocketPoolManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket pool manager with parameters for connection jobs, pool type, and cleanup behavior.

methods.name: FlushSocketPoolsWithError
methods.description: Flushes all socket pools with a specified error code and log reason.

methods.name: CloseIdleSockets
methods.description: Closes idle sockets in all pools with a specified log reason.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a socket pool for a given proxy server, with special handling for WebSocket pools.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Serializes socket pool information into a JSON value.
